stories.headline: Morena and allies reach agreement on Sheinbaum's 'Plan B' electoral reform
stories.summary: After initial rejection of electoral reform, President Sheinbaum announced a 'Plan B' proposal. Morena, PT, and PVEM reached agreement to support the scaled-back version, which includes recall election provisions and aims to reduce costs in local congresses and eliminate political privileges.

articles.title: Plan B de reforma electoral: Morena y aliados llegan a acuerdo para apoyar propuesta de Claudia Sheinbaum
Morena, PT y PVEM cierran filas en torno al plan B de reforma electoral de Sheinbaum

stories.headline: Sheinbaum meets with German President Steinmeier in Cancún
stories.summary: German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier made an official visit to Mexico, meeting with President Sheinbaum in Cancún to discuss commercial relations, economic cooperation, and the EU-Mexico trade agreement update. Steinmeier invited Sheinbaum to visit Germany.

articles.title: Sheinbaum analizará visita a Alemania tras reunión con Steinmeier
Presidente de Alemania hace visita oficial a México; se reunirá con Sheinbaum en Quintana Roo

stories.headline: Sheinbaum responds positively to Spanish King's acknowledgment of conquest abuses
stories.summary: President Sheinbaum welcomed King Felipe VI's recent comments acknowledging abuses during Spain's conquest of Mexico, calling it progress in bilateral relations. She invited the King to the 2026 World Cup, signaling improved ties after tensions during AMLO's presidency.

articles.title: Sheinbaum responde a declaraciones del rey Felipe sobre abusos en la Conquista
Sheinbaum invita al Rey de España al Mundial 2026: ¿Qué dice la carta que le envió a Felipe VI?

stories.headline: Sheinbaum rejects US military intervention proposals, emphasizes sovereignty
stories.summary: President Sheinbaum publicly rejected US proposals for joint military operations against cartels, stating cooperation would continue 'without subordination.' This came in response to Trump's criticism that Mexico should accept US help against organized crime.

articles.title: Sheinbaum responde a Trump: la soberanía nacional no se negocia
Trump insiste que Sheinbaum 'no debería haber rechazado' su 'ayuda' contra cárteles

stories.headline: AMLO calls for citizen donations to Cuba, government announces additional aid
stories.summary: Former President López Obrador made a public call for citizen donations to help Cuba amid its crisis. President Sheinbaum supported the initiative, announced another aid ship to Cuba, and several Morena politicians said they would donate salaries.

articles.title: 'Yo creo que sí': Sheinbaum responde si hará donación personal a Cuba
México enviará otro barco con ayuda a Cuba: Sheinbaum

stories.headline: García Harfuch meets with US security officials, CJNG remains dangerous after El Mencho
stories.summary: Security Secretary García Harfuch met with FBI Director Kash Patel and DEA Director Terrance Cole in Washington to discuss bilateral security cooperation. He stated that despite El Mencho's death, the CJNG cartel remains highly dangerous and active.

articles.title: García Harfuch se reúne con director del FBI en Washington
Cayó 'El Mencho', pero el CJNG sigue vigente, reconoce García Harfuch

stories.headline: Teachers' union CNTE threatens World Cup boycott, maintains protests
stories.summary: The CNTE teachers' union threatened to boycott the 2026 World Cup and blocked Paseo de la Reforma demanding direct meetings with President Sheinbaum. She responded that dialogue remains open but rejected their demands to personally lead negotiations.

articles.title: Sheinbaum responde a 'amenaza' de la CNTE de boicotear el Mundial 2026: 'El diálogo está abierto'
CNTE bloquea paseo de la Reforma y exige reunión con Sheinbaum

stories.headline: Sheinbaum announces mandatory digital payments for gas stations and tolls
stories.summary: President Sheinbaum announced that digital payment will become mandatory for gas stations and toll roads before the end of 2026. Banxico launched initiatives to promote digital payments and reduce cash usage through standardized interfaces.

articles.title: Adiós al 'cash': Sheinbaum anuncia pago con tarjeta obligatorio de casetas y gasolinas para este año
Banxico anuncia reforma para facilitar transferencias electrónicas

stories.headline: García Harfuch explains detention and release of 'El Mayo' Zambada's daughter
stories.summary: Security Secretary García Harfuch clarified that Mónica Zambada Niebla, daughter of drug lord 'El Mayo' Zambada, was temporarily detained during operations in Sinaloa but released because no arrest warrants existed in Mexico or the US.

articles.title: Harfuch aclara por qué Mónica 'N' fue liberada: 'No tiene orden de aprehensión en México ni EU'
Harfuch asegura que Mónica Zambada Niebla no cuenta con orden de aprehensión ni en México ni en EEUU

stories.headline: Pemex commemorates 88th anniversary amid fire at Dos Bocas refinery
stories.summary: Mexico commemorated the 88th anniversary of oil expropriation on March 18. During the same period, a fire at the Dos Bocas refinery killed five people. Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas was appointed to head a new petroleum advisory commission at Pemex.

articles.title: Incendio en refinería 'Olmeca': ¿Quiénes son las víctimas del accidente en la planta de Pemex?
Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas dirigirá nueva área en Pemex: así fue su nombramiento por Sheinbaum

stories.headline: Mexico and US begin T-MEC trade agreement review discussions
stories.summary: Economy Secretary Marcelo Ebrard announced that Mexico and the United States began technical discussions in Washington for the review of the T-MEC trade agreement. Mexico will propose maintaining the agreement, eliminating tariffs, and strengthening supply chains.

articles.title: Revisión del T-MEC: México y Estados Unidos Inician Discusiones Sobre el Tratado Comercial

stories.headline: Foreign direct investment in Mexico grew 132% in 2025 to $7.3 billion
stories.summary: Mexico's foreign direct investment reached $7.377 billion in 2025, growing 132.8% according to the Economy Ministry. Mexico City led with 48% of investments, followed by Baja California Sur and Quintana Roo, showing regional inequality in investment distribution.

articles.title: Inversión extranjera en México crece 132% en 2025, pero revela fuerte desigualdad entre estados

stories.headline: SEDENA deploys 1,170 soldiers to reinforce security in Tijuana, Juárez and León
stories.summary: The Mexican Army deployed 1,170 military personnel to Tijuana, Ciudad Juárez, and León to strengthen security operations against criminal groups. SEDENA also conducted security exercises in preparation for the 2026 World Cup.

articles.title: Sedena despliega 1,170 militares en Tijuana, Juárez y León para reforzar seguridad
SEDENA ensaya blindaje total rumbo al Mundial 2026 en México

stories.headline: Anticorrupción reveals list of millionaire pensions for ex-officials
stories.summary: The Anticorrupción Secretariat published names of former officials receiving 'golden pensions' from Pemex, CFE, and other state entities, some exceeding 1 million pesos monthly. The list was later corrected with lower amounts for six former Pemex employees.

articles.title: ¿Quiénes recibían pensiones millonarias? Revelan lista de extrabajadores de Luz y Fuerza, Pemex y CFE
Anticorrupción corrige monto de seis 'pensiones doradas' de extrabajadores de Pemex
